west end of the alley printed (NOT OPENED), inside the block

notes: Streets: HILL (50', faces y~566/741) across the top; CELESTIAL (40', west edge; east face x~393, centre east face minus 20 ft, pipe at x~316) runs from north of Hill down to E. 3rd and ends there (hatched steps drawn inside it just north of 3rd, x~318-346, y~1330-1400); ST. GREGORY (printed, opening x~1070-1237, no width printed) ends at Hill from the north; E. 3RD (50', faces y~1435/1600); MARTIN (50') diagonal ENE from the west edge (y~2530 north face at x 725) to Parsons; E. FRONT diagonal ENE along the rail yard (north face only, 32 printed by the alley mouth; centres taken midway between the north face and the first railroad track, about 38 ft); PARSONS (printed, 33', faces x~3685/3787 near Martin) runs from Martin down to E. Front, narrowing to about 23 ft between the Elsmere building and a diagonal east face near Front. The 'ALLEY' printed at x~1322-1356 from Martin to Front (10', 4 in. W.P.) is the continuation of COPPINS ALLEY on sheet 108 (same 10 ft width and position relative to Martin and Front), so it carries that name here. PERPENDICULAR ALLEY (15') between Hill and 3rd at x~2424-2480 is drawn as WOOD STEPS for its whole length, so it is listed under alleys (with the steps noted) rather than as two intersections. The area west of x~725 between 3rd and Martin is drawn on sheet 108 (label 108) and the area north of 3rd east of Perpendicular Alley is on sheet 110; a 4 ft passage at x~725-745 runs from the 10' alley down to Martin (not recorded). 3rd and Martin run side by side ENE east of the bend, separated by the retaining wall (WALL 1 TO 40 FEET HIGH), which ends at x~3570; sheet 110 shows them merging there into one street printed E. 3RD (house numbers 1101 on at Parsons), so the Martin/3rd merge is recorded at (3650,1288) (a Y, good to about +-30 px; 3rd's own north side is only drawn on sheet 110) and Parsons' north end is recorded against E. 3rd. The 10' alley printed (NOT OPENED) runs from inside the block to Parsons. Railroad tracks and the river ignored. Parsons/3rd uses 3rd's south face east of Parsons (block corner at x~3790, y~1345) minus 25 ft.
